title: MagiCling Split Smart Food Kitchen Scale – 1g Precision, 22lb/7 Units, Detachable Magnetic Display & Ultra-Slim 14mm Design for Weight Loss, Baking, Cooking, Dieting, Meal Prep
description:
About this item
Split Design & Magnetic Freedom – Weigh on the stainless steel base, then detach LCD screen! Mount it on walls/fridge with the adhesive metal plate or tilt it on the desktop via built-in stand.
1g to 10kg High Accuracy – Perfect for coffee beans (1g) and holiday turkeys (10kg/22lb) with professional-grade sensors.
7 Units & Tare Function – Switch between grams, lb:oz, mL, fl.oz, milk ml, kg, tl; subtract container weight instantly for seamless recipes.
Space-Saving & Travel-Ready – Ultra-slim 14mm body (thinner than a pencil!) and detachable parts fit in drawers, bags, or tiny kitchens.
Smart Features for Hassle-Free Use – Backlit LCD screen, 2-minute auto-off, 4x AA batteries included, and waterproof stainless steel platform.
reviews_5s:
This was a great purchase. The price was affordable and the ease of use is simple. I like the tare weight to help increase the accuracy of the vegetables that I am weighing. The look is sleek and small. It is quite functional.Very nice. Easy to read the weightJust bought another spare. I love this little scale. All I'm going to say is "buy one while you still can".Seams to be quite accurate. I zeroed out the scale with my measuring cup, added water till it hit 8oz. Checked the measuring cop and it was right at the 8oz mark. Love that you can see the scale reading regardless of the size of the item on the scale.I never realized just how awkward it was to use a one piece scale. You may not think it's a big deal, but I discovered after getting this that you have to do some yoga to see the screen on a one piece scale, with something big on it, or a bowl, etc. This one is great and doesn't have that problem. The screen portion is magnetic and easy to place on the fridge when not in use. the controls are simple and functional with very distinctive feel buttons that you will know you pushed. The scale portion is very thin and turns on easy and quickly with the big button on the side. I was concerned that 2 pieces would make me use it less, and it actually makes me use it more! As a person who has gone through several kitchen scales, this one is my favorite.A very unique food scale, I wasn't expecting that there are 2 parts to this scale as it wasn't obvious from the title. The weighing part and the display are 2 separate standalone pieces, each requiring 2 AAA batteries. All 4 batteries are provided. The display piece can be kept elsewhere and also has a magnetic back so can be hung up! Really cool and interesting idea and I am already enjoying the convenience. I found the scale accurate with a test weight.I am impressed with this food scale. I make my dog’s food and need a scale to weigh it for proper proportions. This scale makes it super easy. My favorite thing about it is the separate LCD display that I can set away from the scale and easily see as I weigh the food. It is large, easy to see and it seems pretty spot on. The scale is easy to clean and has a good amount of surface to weigh everything I need it to on. I’m happy with this food scale and would order it again!I put the included AAA batteries (2 in the scale, 2 in the display), turned it on, and it immediately connected. Unlike my postage scale, which constantly drifts around, this one is rock-solid, put the item on the scale and the reading stays steady. I like the wireless display because you can put something larger on the scale and still read the weight. The display has magnets on the back to hang on a refrigerator, but it also comes with some little metal pads you can stick to a non-magnetic surface if you want to hang it there. Would recommend.This is a nice little kitchen scale. It is nice that the screen is separate from the base. This helps when you have a large bowl on the scale that you can still easily see the measurements.This scale has a unique remote display feature that makes it much more useful than the typical kitchen scale. The remote display works well with fast response time and reasonable range (I didn't explore the maximum range, but it easily works out to 6 feet).

I tested the scale with a 100g calibration weight and it showed exact. When loaded with 10000g, (10kg), removing the calibration weight showed 9900g. So it is accurate at both ends of its measurement range.

There is no mention in the instructions if the weighing unit is waterproof or not (I assume it isn't) but it seems pretty robust.

My only quibble with this scale is that it turns itself off after 150 seconds which is too short of a timeout for cooking. When loaded, I like a scale to have at least 10 minutes, preferably 20 minutes of timeout since it is so easy to get distracted when cooking.

Overall I really like that the NIPNSCI scale has a remote display which makes it much easier to read when weighing larger or bulky items like mixing bowls.
